name-zh: 不对称英雄区
description-en: Split the hero into a 7:5 or 3:2 ratio instead of centering everything. Headline left, a subtle dot-grid or gradient bleed right. Never center the hero at Variance ≥ 4. No bouncing scroll arrows, no 'Scroll to explore' filler.
description-zh: 英雄区用 7:5 或 3:2 不对称切分，标题左置，右侧点缀淡网点或渐变色渗。Variance ≥ 4 时禁止居中。禁止弹跳滚动箭头、禁止'下滑探索'填充文字。

name-en: Card Grid — No Three Equal Columns
name-zh: 卡片网格 — 禁止三等宽
description-en: The generic 3-equal-card feature row is an AI cliché and is banned. Use a 12-column grid with 5+7, 4+8, or 8+4 Z-pattern spans. Cards get a 1px hairline border and no shadow by default; hover adds a 1px lift and darkens the border.
description-zh: 三等宽卡片行是 AI 陈词滥调，禁止。用 12 列网格，5+7、4+8 或 8+4 的 Z 形跨度。卡片默认仅 1px 发丝线边框，不放阴影；悬停时抬 1px 并加深边框色。

name-zh: 发丝线边框卡片
description-en: Cards should use a 1px hairline border (rgba(20,58,92,0.10)) and no shadow by default. Hover: translateY(-1px) + border darkens to the accent's 300 tint. Shadow only appears as a hover subtraction — never additive. Never use heavy box-shadow as the default card treatment.
description-zh: 卡片默认 1px 发丝线边框 rgba(20,58,92,0.10)，不放阴影。悬停：translateY(-1px) + 边框加深至主色 300 级。阴影仅作为悬停减法效果——从不叠加。禁止默认粗阴影卡片。

name-zh: 搜索框 — 焦点环
description-en: A hairline-bordered input with a 3px accent focus ring (box-shadow, not outline). Placeholder in tertiary ink. Rounded corners at 10px. Label above in uppercase 0.7rem tracking 0.12em. Never use floating labels.
description-zh: 发丝线边框输入框，聚焦时 3px 主色环（用 box-shadow 而非 outline）。placeholder 用三级墨色。10px 圆角。标签在上方，大写 0.7rem，字距 0.12em。禁止浮动标签。

name-zh: clamp() 字体阶梯
description-en: Build a fluid type scale using CSS clamp(). Display: clamp(2.25rem, 5.2vw, 3.75rem), heading: clamp(2rem, 3.6vw, 2.75rem), body: 1rem. Line-height 1.65 for body, 1.15 for headings. Max 65 characters per line. Never use pure px-only font-size without a clamp fallback for responsive.
description-zh: 用 CSS clamp() 做流体字体阶梯：Display clamp(2.25rem,5.2vw,3.75rem)、Heading clamp(2rem,3.6vw,2.75rem)、正文 1rem。正文行高 1.65，标题 1.15。每行最长 65 字符。禁止只用 px 定字号无 clamp 适配。

name-zh: 单主色法则
description-en: Use exactly one brand accent color. Saturation below 80%. Derive a light tint for backgrounds and a deep shade for text/active states. The accent appears only on: CTAs, focus rings, active nav states, and link underlines. Never add a second accent. Gold/orange/yellow are reserved for identity marks, not functional UI.
description-zh: 只用一个品牌主色，饱和度低于 80%。派生浅色背景和深色文字/激活态。主色仅用于：CTA 按钮、焦点环、导航激活态、链接下划线。禁止加第二个主色。金/橙/黄保留给身份标记，不能做功能色。

name-zh: 错落入场动画
description-en: Cards and list items should reveal with a cascading stagger: 0.05s, 0.13s, 0.21s, 0.29s, 0.37s. Use a spring-out cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) and animate only transform + opacity. Duration ~0.45s. Never animate width, height, top, or left.
description-zh: 卡片和列表项用级联错落入场：0.05s, 0.13s, 0.21s, 0.29s, 0.37s。用弹性出 cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)，仅动画 transform + opacity，时长约 0.45s。禁止动画 width/height/top/left。

name-zh: 导航 — 干净顶栏
description-en: A white surface header with a 1px bottom border. Logo left, nav links center or right. Mobile: stack to single column, logo centered. Active nav link underlined with the accent. No sticky header unless content height justifies it. No hamburger menu on desktop. No dropdown mega-menus.
description-zh: 白色顶栏，底部 1px 边框。Logo 左侧，导航链接居中或靠右。移动端竖排堆叠，Logo 居中。当前页用主色下划线标识。桌面端禁止汉堡菜单、禁止下拉巨型菜单。仅当内容高度合理时才用粘性定位。

name-zh: 页脚 — 编辑式收束
description-en: White surface, top hairline, centered. Row 1: copyright. Row 2: friend links in uppercase 0.75rem tracking 0.1em. No heavy dark background — the footer should feel like the end of a page, not a separate zone. A 1px gold rule at the very top of the footer adds a warm close.
description-zh: 白色面，顶发丝线，居中。第一行版权，第二行友链大写 0.75rem 字距 0.1em。不用深色厚重底——页脚应该像页面的自然结束，而非独立区域。页脚最顶加 1px 金色线做温暖收束。

name-zh: 主按钮 — 扁平实心
description-en: A single primary CTA per viewport. Flat fill (accent dark), no shadow at rest, hairline bottom 1px for tactile depth. Hover: darken, lift 1px. Disabled: 40% opacity + not-allowed cursor. Never use neon outer glows, never put two primary buttons side by side, never use gradient fill on a button that also has a shadow.
description-zh: 每视口最多一个主 CTA。扁平实心填充（主色深色），静止时不加阴影，底部 1px 细线提供触觉深度。悬停：加深、抬 1px。禁用：40% 透明度 + not-allowed 光标。禁止霓虹外发光、禁止并排两个主按钮、禁止渐变填充同时加阴影。

name-zh: 代码块 — 终端风格
description-en: A dark surface code block with macOS traffic-light dots (red/yellow/green) in the top-left. Background: deep ink-tinted dark #0F2438. Text: soft blue-tinted light #DCEBF8. Mono font, rounded corners, subtle sky border. The traffic lights are CSS ::before decorative only. Never use a light-background code block — it reads as a note, not code.
description-zh: 深色代码块，左上角 macOS 红绿灯装饰。底 #0F2438 墨蓝色，字 #DCEBF8 蓝调浅色。等宽字体，圆角，天蓝细边框。红绿灯纯 CSS ::before 装饰。禁止浅色代码块——读起来像注释。
css: pre{position:relative;background:#0F2438;color:#DCEBF8;padding:24px 20px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.65;border:1px solid rgba(115,185,230,.18);overflow-x:auto}pre::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:12px;left:16px;width:38px;height:8px;background:radial-gradient(circle 3px at 4px 4px,#ED6A5E 60%,transparent 62%)0 0/14px 8px no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 3px at 4px 4px,#F4BF4F 60%,transparent 62%)14px 0/14px 8px no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle 3px at 4px 4px,#61C554 60%,transparent 62%)28px 0/14px 8px no-repeat}

name-zh: 骨架屏 — 形状匹配
description-en: Instead of a generic spinner, use skeleton placeholders that match the final layout dimensions. Light gray background with a shimmer animation (linear gradient sweeping left to right, 1.5s). Never use a single circular spinner as the only loading indicator for a content-heavy page.
description-zh: 不要通用转圈，用与最终布局尺寸匹配的骨架占位。浅灰底色 + 微光动画 1.5s，与最终内容形状一致。禁止内容型页面仅用一个圆形转圈作加载指示。

name-zh: 空状态 — 完整构图
description-en: An empty state needs: a small illustration or icon (48-64px, accent tint), a short heading, a 1-line description, and a single primary CTA. All centered with generous whitespace. Never show an empty-state heading without a CTA.
description-zh: 空状态需要：小插图/图标 48-64px 主色着色、简短标题、一行描述、一个主 CTA。全部居中宽裕留白。禁止有空状态标题却不跟 CTA。

name-zh: 容器查询 — 组件驱动响应式
description-en: Use @container queries to style a component based on its own width, not the viewport. This means a card placed in a 300px sidebar automatically switches to a vertical layout, while the same card in a 900px main area uses a horizontal layout — without media queries. Adopted by 40%+ of developers in 2023 State of CSS, now production-ready in Chrome and Firefox.
description-zh: 用 @container 查询让组件根据自身宽度决定样式，而非视口。同一张卡片，放在 300px 侧边栏里自动切竖排，放在 900px 主区域自动变横排——无需媒体查询。2023 年已有 40%+ 开发者使用，现已在 Chrome 和 Firefox 生产可用。

name-zh: CSS 级联层 — 驯服优先级
description-en: Use @layer to organize stylesheets into explicit priority tiers: reset → base → components → utilities. This eliminates specificity wars and !important chains in large codebases. The browser resolves layers in declared order, making the cascade predictable regardless of selector complexity.
description-zh: 用 @layer 将样式表组织为明确的优先级层级：reset → base → components → utilities。这消除了大型项目中的优先级战争和 !important 链。浏览器按声明顺序解析层级，无论选择器多复杂，级联行为都可预测。

name-zh: 极简表单 — 仅底线输入框
description-en: Form inputs with only a 1px bottom border, no box border, no inner shadow. This creates a clean, editorial feel. On focus, the bottom border thickens to 2px and changes to the accent color. Label floats up or stays above. The form stays scannable because visual noise (box borders) is removed.
description-zh: 表单输入框只有一条 1px 底部线，无边框、无内阴影。干净、有编辑质感。聚焦时底部线变粗为 2px 并变色为主色调。Label 浮动或保持在上方。因为没有边框噪音，表单整体更易扫读。
anti: border on all 4 sides for clean layouts

name-zh: 焦点环 — 偏移可见
description-en: Replace the browser default focus outline with a 3px ring offset 3px from the element, using the brand accent color. Always respect prefers-reduced-motion for the transition. Never remove :focus-visible entirely — it breaks keyboard navigation accessibility. The ring should be visible but subtle: a 2-3px solid ring with 3px offset.
description-zh: 替换浏览器默认焦点样式为 3px 环，距元素 3px 偏移，使用品牌色。永远不要完全移除 :focus-visible——这会破坏键盘导航无障碍。焦点环应可见但克制：2-3px 实线环，3px 偏移。
anti: focus ring that blends with background

name-zh: 渐变文字 — Hero 标题点缀
description-en: Clip a linear gradient to text for hero headlines. Use only for 1-2 lines of large display text (≥ 2rem). The gradient should be subtle — 2-3 stops within the brand palette. Never apply to body text, long paragraphs, or functional labels. Always provide a solid fallback color for browsers that don't support background-clip: text.
description-zh: 将线性渐变剪切到文字上，仅用于 1-2 行大字号的展示级标题（≥ 2rem）。渐变应克制——2-3 个色标在品牌色板内。禁止用于正文、长段落或功能标签。务必提供不支持 background-clip: text 的浏览器的纯色回退。

name-zh: 粘性头部 — 毛玻璃背景模糊
description-en: A sticky navigation bar with backdrop-filter: blur() and a semi-transparent background. This creates a modern glass-morphism effect that lets content show through subtly while keeping the nav readable. The blur should be 8-12px — too much creates a foggy blob; too little fails to obscure underlying text. Always add a subtle bottom border to define the header edge when over complex backgrounds.
description-zh: 粘性导航栏使用 backdrop-filter: blur() 和半透明背景，创造现代毛玻璃效果。内容微透但不影响导航可读性。模糊值 8-12px——过重像雾气，过轻无法遮挡下方文字。务必在复杂背景上添加底部细线以定义 header 边界。

name-zh: 滚动吸附 — 逐页故事叙述
description-en: Use CSS scroll-snap for section-by-section vertical storytelling. The parent gets scroll-snap-type: y mandatory; children get scroll-snap-align: start. This creates a native, performant page-by-page experience without JavaScript scrolljacking. Always provide a way to skip (e.g., a dot nav) and respect prefers-reduced-motion to disable snapping.
description-zh: 用 CSS scroll-snap 实现逐页纵向叙述。父容器设 scroll-snap-type: y mandatory，子元素设 scroll-snap-align: start。无需 JavaScript 劫持滚动即实现原生的、高性能的翻页体验。务必提供跳过方式（如点导航），并尊重 prefers-reduced-motion 禁用吸附。

name-zh: 折叠面板 — 原生 <details>/<summary>
description-en: Use the native HTML <details> and <summary> elements for accordions instead of building custom ones from divs. They are accessible by default (keyboard, screen readers), require zero JavaScript for toggle behavior, and can be styled with CSS. Add a custom marker via ::marker or a rotated chevron via ::after on summary.
description-zh: 用原生 HTML <details> 和 <summary> 元素做折叠面板，而非用 div 自行搭建。默认无障碍（键盘、屏幕阅读器）、零 JavaScript 切换、纯 CSS 可定制样式。通过 ::marker 或 summary::after 添加旋转箭头图标。

name-zh: 提示框 — 纯 CSS 悬停/聚焦
description-en: A CSS-only tooltip using ::after pseudo-element positioned relative to the trigger element. Appears on hover and focus (keyboard accessible). The tooltip should never cover the trigger element itself. Use a small caret arrow and keep text to 1-2 lines max. For complex content, use a popover or dialog instead.
description-zh: 用 ::after 伪元素定位在触发元素旁边实现纯 CSS 提示框。悬停和聚焦时出现（键盘可访问）。提示框绝不能遮挡触发元素本身。用一个小三角箭头，文字最多 1-2 行。复杂内容请用 popover 或 dialog。
anti: no focus support for keyboard users

name-zh: 类命名 — 有意义、连字符分隔
description-en: Class names must reflect purpose, not appearance. Use .gallery, .login, .video — never .button-green or .yee-1901. Separate words with hyphens (.video-id), never underscores or camelCase. Keep names as short as possible but as long as necessary — .nav over .navigation, but never .atr for .author. Optionally prefix with an app-specific namespace in large projects (.adw-help). Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: 类名必须反映用途而非外观。用 .gallery、.login、.video——禁用 .button-green 或 .yee-1901。连字符分隔单词 (.video-id)，禁用下划线或驼峰。尽量短但够清晰——用 .nav 而非 .navigation，但不能把 .author 缩成 .atr。大型项目可用应用前缀 (.adw-help)。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: No ID Selectors — Use Class Selectors
name-zh: 禁用 ID 选择器 — 用 class 替代
description-en: ID selectors (#example) are banned for styling. IDs must be unique across the entire page — impossible to guarantee in a multi-component, multi-engineer codebase. Class selectors are preferred in all situations. If an id attribute is absolutely required, its value must contain a hyphen (user-profile, not userProfile) to avoid becoming a global JavaScript variable on window. Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: ID 选择器 (#example) 在样式中禁止使用。ID 必须在整个页面唯一——在多组件、多工程师的代码库中无法保证。所有场景优先使用 class 选择器。如果必须使用 id 属性，值必须含连字符 (user-profile 而非 userProfile)，以避免成为 window 上的全局 JavaScript 变量。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-zh: !important — 禁用，修复优先级代替
description-en: The !important declaration breaks the natural cascade and makes styles impossible to reason about. Once one !important appears, others follow in an escalating war that no one wins. Fix the root cause: restructure selectors, use cascade layers (@layer), or refactor the component hierarchy. The only acceptable use is overriding third-party inline styles when no other option exists. Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: !important 声明会破坏自然级联，让样式变得不可推理。一个 !important 出现后，其他人跟着加，形成一场无人获胜的升级战争。修复根本原因：重构选择器、使用级联层 (@layer)、或重构组件层级。唯一可接受的使用场景是别无选择时覆盖第三方内联样式。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: Avoid Qualifying Class with Type Selector
name-zh: 避免用元素类型限定 class 选择器
description-en: Writing ul.example or div.error ties the style to a specific HTML element for no benefit. If the element changes (div → section), the style silently breaks. Just write .example or .error — it's more reusable, more performant, and avoids unnecessary specificity. Only qualify when the class genuinely means different things on different elements (rare). Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: 写 ul.example 或 div.error 把样式绑定到特定 HTML 元素上，毫无好处。如果元素变了（div → section），样式悄悄失效。只写 .example 或 .error——更可复用、性能更好、避免不必要优先级。仅当 class 在不同元素上确实有不同含义时才限定（罕见）。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: Shorthand Properties — Prefer Compact over Longhand
name-zh: 简写属性 — 优先紧凑写法
description-en: Use CSS shorthand properties whenever possible, even when only one value is explicitly set. margin: 0 0 1em is clearer and more maintainable than margin-bottom: 1em alone — it communicates intent that the other sides are deliberately zero. Shorthand is easier to scan and less prone to partial-override bugs. Exceptions: when only setting one value of a truly unrelated set (e.g., background-position alone is fine). Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: 尽可能使用 CSS 简写属性，即使只显式设置了一个值。margin: 0 0 1em 比单独 margin-bottom: 1em 更清晰、更易维护——它传达了其他边故意设为零的意图。简写更易扫读，更少部分覆盖 bug。例外：只设置一组无关属性中的某一个（如单独 background-position 可以）。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-zh: 零值不带单位 — 禁止 0px 或 0em
description-en: Zero is zero regardless of unit. Write margin: 0 not margin: 0px. Cleaner, shorter, and the only universally agreed CSS convention. The sole exception is flex-basis (flex: 1 1 0px required in some browsers). Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: 零就是零，无论什么单位。写 margin: 0 而非 margin: 0px。更干净、更短、CSS 社区唯一公认约定。唯一例外是 flex-basis（某些浏览器需要 flex: 1 1 0px）。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: Hex Colors — Use 3-Char Shorthand When Possible
name-zh: 十六进制颜色 — 能用 3 位就用 3 位
description-en: #eebbcc should be written as #ebc. Shorter hex codes are easier to scan, and the 3-char form communicates that the color is a 'clean' value from the 216-color web-safe-ish palette. Never use uppercase hex (#EBC). Only use 6-char when the color genuinely cannot be abbreviated. Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: #eebbcc 应写为 #ebc。更短的十六进制更易扫读，且 3 位形式传达了颜色来自 216 色干净色板的信号。禁止大写十六进制 (#EBC)。仅当颜色确实无法缩写时才用 6 位。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: No Inline Styles — Separation of Concerns
name-zh: 禁止内联样式 — 结构表现分离
description-en: HTML documents should contain only structural markup. All presentation goes in CSS stylesheets; all behavior goes in JavaScript files. Inline styles (<div style='...'>) blur this boundary and make the codebase unmaintainable. Every inline style is a style that cannot be cached, cannot be themed, and cannot be overridden without !important. Keep the contact surface between HTML and CSS as small as possible. Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: HTML 文档只应包含结构化标记。所有表现放在 CSS 样式表里，所有行为放在 JavaScript 文件里。内联样式 (<div style='...'>) 模糊了这个边界，让代码库不可维护。每个内联样式都是一个不能被缓存、不能被主题化、不能用 !important 之外方式覆盖的样式。保持 HTML 和 CSS 的接触面尽可能小。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: Semantic HTML — Elements for Their Purpose
name-zh: 语义化 HTML — 元素各司其职
description-en: Use HTML elements for their intended purpose: headings for headings, p for paragraphs, a for anchors, button for buttons. Never use <div onclick='...'> when <a> or <button> is the correct element — this breaks keyboard navigation, screen readers, and SEO. Semantic HTML is a measurable quality baseline that pays dividends in accessibility, code efficiency, and maintainability. Source: Google HTML/CSS Style Guide.
description-zh: 按预期用途使用 HTML 元素：标题用 heading、段落用 p、链接用 a、按钮用 button。禁止 <div onclick='...'> 替代 <a> 或 <button>——这会破坏键盘导航、屏幕阅读器和 SEO。语义化 HTML 是可衡量的质量基线，在无障碍、代码效率和可维护性方面持续产生红利。源自 Google HTML/CSS 风格指南。

name-en: Three AI Cliché Palettes — Actively Avoid
name-zh: 三种 AI 陈词滥调色板 — 主动避开
description-en: Three color palettes appear so often in AI-generated UIs that they have become defaults rather than choices: (1) Warm cream background (#F4F1EA) + high-contrast serif display + terracotta accent; (2) Near-black background + single bright acid-green or vermilion accent; (3) Broadsheet layout with hairline rules and dense newspaper columns. Unless the brief explicitly requests one of these, choose something else. Derive your palette from the subject's world, not from statistical averages. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 三种色板在 AI 生成界面中出现频率极高，已成默认而非选择：(1) 暖奶油底色 (#F4F1EA) + 高对比衬线标题 + 赤陶点缀；(2) 近黑底色 + 单一亮酸绿或朱红点缀；(3) 报纸排版 + 发丝线分隔 + 密集列。除非需求明确要求，选择其他方案。从项目主题的世界中提取色板，而非从统计平均中获取。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: any palette chosen because 'AI usually picks this'
design without a subject to derive from

name-zh: Hero 区域 — 论点而非模板
description-en: A hero section should open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world — it is a thesis statement, not a template. Avoid the 'big number with a small label, supporting stats, and gradient accent' pattern unless it is genuinely the best option. The hero sets the tone for the entire page; if it reads like every other landing page, the user has already formed their impression before scrolling. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: Hero 区域应该用主题世界中最有特征的东西开场——它是一个论点，不是一个模板。避免「大数字 + 小标签 + 支撑数据 + 渐变点缀」的套路，除非它确实是最佳选择。Hero 为整页定调；如果它读起来和其他着陆页一模一样，用户在滚动前就已经下了判断。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: big number + small label + stats + gradient hero
hero that doesn't reference the subject's world
hero that could belong to any company

name-zh: 排版即身份 — 刻意的字体搭配
description-en: Typography carries the personality of the page. Pair display and body faces deliberately — not the same generic sans-serif families you would reach for on any other project. Use at minimum 2+ roles: a characterful display face (used with restraint), a complementary body face, and optionally a utility face for captions and data. Define a clear type scale with intentional weights, widths, and spacing. The type treatment itself should be a memorable part of the design, not a neutral delivery vehicle. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 排版承载页面的个性。刻意搭配展示字体和正文字体——不是你给任何其他项目都会选的同一套通用无衬线字族。最少 2+ 个角色：有性格的展示字体（克制使用）、互补的正文字体，可选工具字体用于标注和数据。定义清晰的字体阶差，权重、宽度、间距都要有意图。字体处理本身就应该是设计中令人难忘的一部分，而非中性的传送工具。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: same sans-serif for display and body
generic system font stack with no character

name-en: One Signature Element — Spend Boldness Once
name-zh: 一个标志性元素 — 大胆只挥霍一次
description-en: Spend your boldness in one place. Let the signature element be the single unique thing this page will be remembered by — keep everything else quiet and disciplined. This could be a distinctive type treatment, an unexpected layout move, a custom illustration style, or an interactive flourish. The key: it's ONE thing. If everything is special, nothing is. Cut any decoration that does not serve the brief. Not taking a risk can be a risk itself — but take only one. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 大胆只挥霍在一处。让标志性元素成为这个页面被记住的唯一独特之处——其余一切保持安静和克制。可能是有个性的字体处理、意外的布局动作、定制插画风格、或交互上的一个闪光点。关键是：就这一处。如果什么都是特别的，就什么都不特别了。删掉任何不服务于需求的装饰。不冒险本身可能就是最大的风险——但只冒一个。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。

name-en: Copy as Design Material — Specific > Clever
name-zh: 文案即设计材料 — 具体胜过聪明
description-en: Words appear in a design for one reason: to make it easier to understand. They are design material, not decoration. Rules: (1) Write from the user's side — name things by what people control, not system architecture. (2) Be specific over clever — 'Save changes' not 'Submit'. (3) Active voice as default — the button says exactly what happens. (4) Maintain action-name consistency — 'Publish' button → 'Published' toast. (5) Errors explain what went wrong and how to fix it — never vague, never apologetic. (6) Empty screens are invitations to act. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 文字在设计中只有一个理由：让理解更容易。它是设计材料，不是装饰。规则：(1) 从用户侧写作——用人们控制的东西命名，不用系统架构。 (2) 具体胜过聪明——「保存更改」而非「提交」。 (3) 默认主动语态——按钮准确说出会发生什么。 (4) 保持一致——「发布」按钮 → 「已发布」提示。 (5) 错误说明出了什么问题以及如何修复——禁止含糊、禁止道歉。 (6) 空页面是行动的邀请函。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: empty state: 'No data' with no action

name-en: Numbers as Information — Earn Every Marker
name-zh: 数字即信息 — 每个标记都要挣来
description-en: Numbered markers (01 / 02 / 03) in UI are only appropriate when the content represents an actual sequence — a real process or a typed timeline where order carries genuine information. Never use numbered markers purely for decoration. The same principle applies to dividers, eyebrows, and labels: every structural device must encode something true about the content. 'Structure is information.' Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 界面中的数字标记 (01 / 02 / 03) 仅在内容代表真实序列时才适用——一个真实的流程或一条有信息含义的时间线。禁止仅为装饰使用数字标记。同样的原则适用于分割线、眉标和标签：每个结构装置都必须编码内容的真实信息。'结构即信息。' 源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: numbered steps that aren't a real sequence
eyebrows and dividers with no semantic meaning

name-en: Motion — One Orchestrated Moment > Scattered Effects
name-zh: 动效 — 一个编排时刻胜过分散特效
description-en: Leverage motion deliberately. Consider page-load sequences, scroll-triggered reveals, hover micro-interactions, and ambient atmosphere — but don't use all of them. An orchestrated moment (e.g., a coordinated hero entrance with staggered reveals) usually lands harder than scattered effects sprinkled everywhere. Sometimes less animation is more — extra motion contributes to the feeling that the design is AI-generated. Always respect prefers-reduced-motion. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 刻意运用动效。考虑页面加载序列、滚动触发揭示、悬停微交互和氛围动画——但不要全用。一个精心编排的时刻（如协调的 Hero 入场 + 错落揭示）通常比到处散落的效果更有冲击力。有时更少动效反而更好——过多的动效贡献了'这像 AI 做的'的感觉。始终尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: more than 2-3 animation types on one page

name-en: Design Tokens — Named Values, Not Raw Hex
name-zh: 设计 Token — 命名值而非裸十六进制
description-en: Define a compact token system of 4-6 named values before writing any CSS. Use CSS custom properties: --ink, --surface, --accent, --line, --shadow. Every color, spacing, and type decision references a token — never a raw hex or px value in a selector body. This makes the design system portable, themeable, and self-documenting. The token names themselves are design decisions: '--gold' tells a story; '#F2B53C' does not. Source: Google Style Guide (alphabetical declaration order) + Anthropic Design Skill (token system).
description-zh: 写 CSS 之前先定义一套 4-6 个命名值的紧凑 token 系统。用 CSS 自定义属性：--ink、--surface、--accent、--line、--shadow。每个颜色、间距、字体决策都引用 token——绝不在选择器体中裸写 hex 或 px 值。这让设计系统可移植、可主题化、自文档化。Token 名称本身就是设计决策：'--gold' 在讲一个故事；'#F2B53C' 没有。源自 Google Style Guide + Anthropic Design Skill。
anti: using px for values that should be tokens

name-en: Empty State — Invitation to Act, Not a Void
name-zh: 空状态 — 行动邀请而非空白
description-en: An empty screen is an invitation to act — never just 'No data' or a blank space. Every empty state should: (1) name what would normally be here, (2) explain the benefit of filling it, and (3) provide a clear action to get started. A well-designed empty state converts a moment of absence into a moment of onboarding. The visual should be friendly but minimal — an illustration or icon, a headline, a sentence of explanation, and one primary CTA. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 空页面是行动的邀请——绝不只是'暂无数据'或一片空白。每个空状态应该：(1) 说明这里通常有什么，(2) 解释填满它的好处，(3) 提供明确的开始行动入口。一个精心设计的空状态把缺失时刻转化为引导时刻。视觉应友好但克制——一个插画或图标、一个标题、一句解释、一个主 CTA。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。

name-en: Responsive Down to Mobile — Quality Floor Without Announcement
name-zh: 响应式到移动端 — 默认品质基线，无需宣告
description-en: Every web design must be responsive down to mobile (320px width) without the user having to ask for it. This is a quality floor, not a feature. Elements that work on desktop must adapt: multi-column grids become single-column, touch targets expand to ≥44px, font sizes remain readable without zoom, and hover-dependent interactions gain tap equivalents. Never hide this behind a 'mobile version' toggle — it should just work. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 每个网页设计必须响应式到移动端 (320px)，用户不需要专门要求。这是品质基线，不是功能。桌面端有效的元素必须适配：多列网格变单列、触摸目标扩展到 ≥44px、字号无需缩放即可读、依赖悬停的交互增加点击替代方案。禁止隐藏在'手机版'按钮后面——应该直接可用。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: hover-only interactions with no tap fallback

name-en: Critique Before Building — Two-Pass Design Process
name-zh: 建造前批判 — 两次通过设计法
description-en: Work in two passes: (1) First produce a design plan — a compact token system (color, type, layout, signature) — and critique it against the brief. Is it unique to this subject, or could this plan be for any similar page? (2) Only write code after confirming the plan is distinctive. During code: watch selector specificity — easily generated classes can cancel each other out. After building, critique again: cut one accessory you thought was essential. Revise generic defaults — if the plan reads like it could be for any similar page, state what you changed and why. Source: Anthropic Frontend Design Skill.
description-zh: 两次通过设计法：(1) 先产出设计计划——一套紧凑 token 系统（颜色、字体、布局、标志元素）——并对着需求批判它。它对这个主题是独特的，还是给任何类似页面都能用？ (2) 确认计划具有区分度后再写代码。编码时：留意选择器优先级——轻松生成的 class 可能相互抵消。建造后再次批判：删掉一个你原以为必要的装饰。修正通用默认值——如果计划读起来像给任何类似页面都能用的，说明你改了什么以及为什么。源自 Anthropic Frontend Design Skill。
anti: plan that fits any generic page
selectors that cancel each other out
